description: Score the cross-sell strength (product affinity) between two specific products. Returns the confidence the merchant's real co-purchase data supports for the pair, or a clear 'no signal' result when there's no qualifying rule. Use this to validate a proposed pair before recommending it, or to answer 'is X a good cross-sell for Y?', 'how strong is the affinity between X and Y?', or 'how often are X and Y bought together?'.

product_a.description: The 'antecedent' product (the one the customer already has).

product_b.description: The 'consequent' product (the one being evaluated as a cross-sell).

name: score_cross_sell
